messages.english: Plan household food or trial growing from your own harvest target, without a buyer order.

translations.zu: Hlela ukudla kwasekhaya noma ukulima kokuhlola kusukela kokuhlosiwe kwesivuno sakho, ngaphandle kwe-oda lomthengi.
translations.st: Rera dijo tsa lelapa kapa temo ya teko ho tswa sepheong sa hao sa kotulo, ntle le taelo ya moreki.
translations.ts: Lulamisa swakudya swa le kaya kumbe kurima ka ndzingelo ku suka eka xikongomelo xa wena xa ntshovelo, handle ka oda ya muxavi.
translations.ve: Pulaneledzani zwiḽiwa zwa muṱani kana u ṱavha ha ndingo u bva kha zwipikwa zwa khaṋo zwaṋu, hu si na ndaela ya murengi.

messages.english: Plan food or a growing trial

translations.st: Rera dijo kapa teko ya ho lema
translations.ts: Lulamisa swakudya kumbe ndzingelo wo rima
translations.ve: Pulaneledzani zwiḽiwa kana ndingo ya u ṱavha

messages.english: Production plan → Automatic plan from your estimates

translations.zu: Uhlelo lokukhiqiza → Uhlelo oluzenzakalelayo olusuka ezilinganisweni zakho
translations.st: Leano la tlhahiso → Leano le itirisang ho tswa dikakanyong tsa hao
translations.ts: Pulani ya vuhumelerisi → Pulani yo tiendlekela ku suka eka miringanyeto ya wena
translations.ve: Mbekanyamushumo ya vhubveledzi → Pulane ya othomethiki i no bva kha nyanganyelo dzaṋu

messages.english: Choose household food or trial growing, enter your gross harvest weight and dates, and use your saved growing estimates and measured spaces. Saved crop records and nursery batches keep the original request. These are planning estimates, not observed harvests or local crop advice.

translations.zu: Khetha ukudla kwasekhaya noma ukulima kokuhlola, faka isisindo sakho sesivuno sisonke nezinsuku, bese usebenzisa izilinganiso zakho zokulima ezilondoloziwe nezikhala ezikaliwe. Amarekhodi ezitshalo alondoloziwe namaqoqo esithombo agcina isicelo sokuqala. Lezi yizilinganiso zokuhlela, hhayi izivuno ezibonwe ngamehlo noma izeluleko zezitshalo zendawo.
translations.st: Kgetha dijo tsa lelapa kapa temo ya teko, kenya boima bohle ba kotulo le matsatsi, mme o sebedise dikakanyo tsa hao tse bolokilweng tsa temo le dibaka tsa temo tse lekantsweng. Direkoto tsa dijalo tse bolokilweng le dihlopha tsa dipeo di boloka kopo ya pele. Tsena ke dikakanyo tsa ho rera, eseng dikotulo tse bonweng kapa keletso ya dijalo tsa lehae.
translations.ts: Hlawula swakudya swa le kaya kumbe kurima ka ndzingelo, nghenisa ntikelo hinkwawo wa ntshovelo na masiku, kutani u tirhisa miringanyeto ya wena yo rima leyi hlayisiweke na tindhawu leti pimiweke. Tirhekhodo ta swimilani leti hlayisiweke na mintlawa ya masungulo ya swimilani swi hlayisa xikombelo xo sungula. Leyi i miringanyeto yo lulamisa, ku nga ri mitshovelo leyi voniweke kumbe switsundzuxo swa swimilani swa laha kaya.
translations.ve: Nangani zwiḽiwa zwa muṱani kana u ṱavha ha ndingo, dzhenisani vhuleme hoṱhe ha khaṋo na maḓuvha, nahone shumisani nyanganyelo dza u ṱavha dzo vhulungwaho na zwikhala zwo pimiwaho. Rekhodo dza zwimela dzo vhulungwaho na zwigwada zwa nese zwi vhulunga khumbelo ya u thoma. Hedzi ndi nyanganyelo dza mbekanyamushumo, hu si khaṋo dzo vhonwaho kana nyeletshedzo ya zwimela zwa henefho.
